_: What every derivation must return for plan.json + board.json. This is the portable half of the contract: pure functions, fixture in, JSON out, identical in any language. A rebuild writes these as tests in the host project's own runner. If one fails, the rebuild disagrees with the design about a number, which is the failure that hides longest.
_readinessPhase: 0: no phase is verified, so readiness follows the effective phase

TSK-000002._points: 8 not 3: board.db's override beats the plan's estimate

TSK-000004._priority: high because a person set it; the phase would have derived normal

ADH-0001._phase: 0, inherited from the epic it names
ADH-0001._points: null - an ad-hoc task has no plan estimate behind it

planStatusOf._: TSK-000003 is parked by an override; the plan still says next-up. Dragging it back to Next up must CLEAR the override, not write next-up.

phaseGatePhase0.leftUnfinished: 2 tasks not done, 1 blocked or in progress
phaseGatePhase0._criteriaMet: 1, not 2. A parked criterion is satisfied but never met.
phaseGatePhase0._open: false because work is outstanding, even though no criterion is unmet

epicColours._: Sorted by phase then title, centrally. Alpha and Beta share a hue because they share a phase.

boardColumns._next-up: TSK-000002 before TSK-000004: equal priority, so phase 0 sorts before phase 1

liveGates._: Only these two are recomputed. Tests and Risks pass through from the plan untouched.

sidebarCounts._board: 3 open: TSK-000002, TSK-000004, ADH-0001. Parked and done are not open.

_phaseProgressPhase0: 1 done of 3 required (4 tasks less 1 parked), rounded
